overview.title: Research & Development Center
overview.tagline: Fostering Interdisciplinary Inquiry, Innovation & Knowledge Creation
overview.description: The Research & Development Cell (RDC) at St. Philomena's College (Autonomous), Mysuru promotes cutting-edge scholarly investigations across basic sciences, humanities, commerce, and computational technologies in accordance with UGC Guidelines.

rdcCommittees.name: Finance & Infrastructure
rdcCommittees.focus: Research lab infrastructure, modern instrumentation grants, computational labs, and seed funding management.

rdcCommittees.name: Research Programs & Policy Development
rdcCommittees.convener: Dr. Felan Amal (Head & Assistant Professor of Physics)
rdcCommittees.focus: Institutional research ethics, NEP research integration, interdisciplinary symposiums, and student fellowship policy.

rdcCommittees.name: Collaboration, MoUs & Community Extension
rdcCommittees.focus: University-industry bilateral agreements, international academic exchange, and community extension research projects.

rdcCommittees.name: Product Development, Monitoring & Commercialization
rdcCommittees.focus: Pre-incubation prototyping, technology transfer, student entrepreneurship, and industry product trials.

rdcCommittees.name: IPR & Ethical Matters
rdcCommittees.focus: Patent drafting, copyright filings, trademark registration, anti-plagiarism checks, and institutional ethics review.
